name: NOVA
author: Konstantin Tarasevic
description: All your local AI models in one place, without the terminal: NOVA shows which models fit your hardware, installs the one you pick, tells you when a newer build is out and updates it with your approval, gives you a private chat in the top bar, and connects OpenCode to a model you have as your own coding assistant.

barWidget.description: Local AI chat, models that fit your PC, approved installs, a coding assistant, live hardware use.

schema.description: Keep the pixel wave still; activity labels and colours still update.
